task: predict progression (PFS) in pediatric posterior mediastinal malignancies from preoperative CT radiomics
note: Progression treated as binary outcome; nomogram combines clinical model (Ki-67, metastasis) with LASSO-logistic radiomics signature built on SMOTE training data. Modality mixed: CT radiomic features plus clinical variables. No model without SMOTE reported.

task: classify lettuce nutrient deficiency (-N, -P, -K, fully nutritional) from leaf images
note: Table 1 gives 72 per class (288) after SMOTE, equal to whole-data counts, contradicting training-only claim; test metrics imply natural 42-image test set. Resampler other: augmentation of FN images (12 to 60); Borderline-SMOTE only an Optuna option.

task: diagnose coronary artery disease from clinical features (Z-Alizadeh Sani dataset)
note: Minority (normal, 87) oversampled to 216 on whole data; 130-sample test set drawn from balanced pool incl. synthetic cases; 5-fold CV run on the 302 resampled training samples; RFE also after SMOTE. Only literature comparison, no no-SMOTE baseline.

task: identify and categorise offensive tweets (SemEval-2019 OffensEval subtasks A-C)
note: SMOTE vs class weights vs none compared only on holdout for subtasks B and C; subtask A used no resampling. Final SemEval official test scores reported. How SMOTE was applied to text sequences not described.

task: assess sarcopenia risk in physically inactive middle-aged and older adults (ELSA, NHANES)
note: Separate models per cohort (ELSA, NHANES), no cross-cohort validation. Grid-search 5-fold CV in training set; whether SMOTE preceded it not stated. Calibration plots and Brier reported for SMOTE-trained models. Shiny tool built, no use results.

task: identify risk factors and predict cardiac implantable electronic device infection (CIEDI)
note: Logistic risk-factor model refit on random-under/over-sampled data (616+123, described as SMOTE); ORs and in-sample ROC compared before/after. Classifier F1 22% vs 93% compares resampled vs proportionally expanded original data, both split after resampling.

task: detect intended sarcasm and ironic speech categories in English and Arabic tweets
note: Only official SemEval-2022 test scores reported (organizers' test set); no own validation results or no-SMOTE baseline. Where SMOTE sat relative to the train/validation split and CV not described. Applied to TF-IDF vectors.

task: predict Crohn's disease-related surgery from EMR records of Chinese patients
note: Split at record level (multiple records per patient), so a patient may appear in training and test. 'TN rate' coded as specificity. No no-SMOTE comparison; RF chosen over LR, DT, SVM, ANN.

task: detect fraudulent credit card and mobile money transactions (CreditCard, PaySim datasets)
note: Resampler-classifier pairs (RF+SMOTE-Tomek, XGB+SMOTEENN, LGBM/XGB+Borderline-SMOTE+Tomek) plus stacking/voting; resampling inside ensembles unspecified. No no-resampling baseline. Training-only resampling shown by step order, not stated in words; test counts confirm untouched test.

task: predict adverse cardiac events from stress MPI parameters (C-SPECT vs CZT-SPECT)
note: Aim is comparing two SPECT cameras, not building a clinical model. 'Recall' refers to no-event class and 'specificity' to events. AUC rose from 0.50-0.61 to up to 0.99 after SMOTE; Sec 2.5: whole dataset rebalanced, then models retrained.
